title: Figure in Red Robe on Rocks
description: A person wearing a long red robe sits on dark jagged rocks looking toward a dramatic sky. The person's face is in profile, their hands rest on the rocks, and the setting is a rocky outcrop under a sky filled with swirling orange, yellow, and dark clouds.
prompt: A person in a flowing red robe sits on jagged dark rocks at the edge of a cliff looking out at a dramatic sky. The figure is seen from the side in profile with hands resting on the rocks. The sky is filled with swirling clouds of bright orange yellow and dark gray with glowing light breaking through. The rocky ground has sharp broken stones and the overall scene uses bold painterly brush strokes.
